networkBoundary: read-only path-normalization utility; source has no sockets/exec/writes; driver launches the program with no path operands and stdin at immediate EOF (it canonicalizes the current directory ".") and contacts no endpoint
note: FreeBSD realpath.c POSIX/BSD C11 -> Windows C++17 (step-04 multi-system POSIX->Windows filesystem batch, 2/4). Cross-OS dual-side build: source C baseline on Linux VM, target C++ on Windows VM. Source baseline neutralizes the FreeBSD-ism __dead2 (-D__dead2=) and exposes POSIX/BSD symbols (-D_POSIX_C_SOURCE=200809L -D_DEFAULT_SOURCE) on the command line without editing the source. Target went GENERATED -> SELF_REVIEWED(REPAIR-RECOMMENDED) -> SELF_REPAIRED(round 1) -> re-review NO-REPAIR-IDENTIFIED; the repair renamed the realpath shim to x_realpath (SDK-collision disambiguation) and restored getopt/optind via <getopt.h> (libmingwex). Compile-quality stage: only build evidence is counted; behavior is not scored and no behavior oracle is set (stdout path text/separator differs by OS by design).
